update.name: Joomla Claude Cowork
update.description: A customer can take any language the quickstart already ships, one or several, and keep it the way the archive built it. Tracy Business ships 41 editions made by its own add-language tool, each with its own menus (`tb-main-vi`), megamenu, modules and categories; a copy made from the source sat in `tb-main-en` while the template reads `tb-main-<sef>`, so `/vi/` lost its main menu. A contract may now carry `editions.json`, generated from the release database and pinned to the base: for such a language the receiver writes the translation into the edition's own rows, shows them, spares them from retire, joins the edition's association group, and a revert returns words and visibility without deleting anything. Inspect holds each taken row to the add-language rules the generator proved against every edition of the release. For a language without an edition the copy road stays, now with: the archive's own rows moved off an alias a copy needs, association groups kept whole, a new switcher placed even when its id matches another kind's, and a second Build able to bind and seed while a language is half made. Carries 0.16.11.

update.name: Joomla Claude Cowork
update.description: A quickstart that ships editions of its own no longer leaves them on a customer's site. `multilingual.retire` hides (never deletes) every content language the customer did not ask for, and every row the archive shipped in a language other than its source that the contract does not govern, so the switcher and hreflang offer only the site's own languages and a derived edition no longer sits beside the archive's. Rows move by their visibility column only (setVisibility, as the demo trim does), so no row's ACL changes; `multilingual.restore` brings a pass back. A switcher the archive already ships (Business reuses its own, so the topbar never carries two) is held to its own lock, assignment and count, not to the shape of a new switcher, so a Business site can gain a language. The door also reserves 300 s of execution beside its memory: a contract inspect of the 43-language Business quickstart outlived PHP's stock 30 s. A language copy keeps its source article's note (Business marks every article), a job taken back never deletes a governed module, and a new switcher whose id matches a governed menu item or article is still placed on every page. Every shipped multilingual contract now runs the whole language road in the test suite before a release. Carries 0.16.10: one language for a quickstart with no second edition.

update.name: Joomla Claude Cowork
update.description: A sealed quickstart with no second edition can be built in the customer's language. New `siteLanguage.plan / set / revert`: the reviewed language pack is installed (verified against the catalog, as for a second edition) and made the default for the site and the administrator, with the previous defaults kept on record for the revert. It needs no multilingual profile — JA Kinetic has none — and refuses a site that already has a second edition. Measured on a local JA Kinetic 1.0.0 site: vi-VN 4.2.2.1 installed and set in 5.8 s, the home page and the administrator answer lang="vi-vn", and the contract inspects clean, demo trim included.

update.name: Joomla Claude Cowork
update.description: Two false refusals that stopped the `language` stage on text Tracy itself shipped. A figure is now compared by its VALUE, not its spelling: Vietnamese writes 4.800 where English writes 4,800 and 6,2 where English writes 6.2, and every locale that groups with a dot or a space hit the same wall — a changed or missing figure is still refused. And an angle bracket counts as markup only where the source has none, so a translation that faithfully keeps an email address in brackets is no longer turned away. Carries the 0.16.5 payload: the tracy-business/j6/1.1.0 multilingual profile.

update.name: Joomla Claude Cowork
update.description: Bundles the tracy-business/j6/1.1.0 multilingual profile, so a Tracy Business site can be given a second language. The profile is written for an archive that is ALREADY two authored editions: its 157 en-GB rows are translated, while the 180 ru-RU rows the customer authored and the rows left at language='*' are declared shared and never copied, and the language switcher the archive already publishes is reused instead of a second one being created.

update.name: Joomla Claude Cowork
update.description: Lets an AI assistant read and, when asked, write this site over one token-authenticated endpoint. Replaces the tracy-business/j6/1.1.0 presentation lock with one captured from the 1.1.0 archive itself, carrying ACL rules for all 6,144 entities of its 43 language editions instead of the 322 of 1.0.0, so bind on a Tracy Business site no longer refuses with an entityRules change. The API door now reserves 512M of PHP memory before loading a profile, so that 8 MB lock decodes on a site left at PHP's 128M default; a higher or unlimited limit is never lowered.
